    export const AVAILABILITY_CONFIG_PREFIX = "/api/v1/venues";
    export const availabilityConfigEndpoints = {
      getConfig: defineEndpoint({
        method: "GET",
        path: `${AVAILABILITY_CONFIG_PREFIX}/:id/availability/config`,
        params: VenueParamsSchema,
        responses: {
          200: {
            description: "The venue's availability configuration and its version",
            body: z.object({ data: AvailabilityConfigStateSchema }),
          },
          401: authRequired,
          403: notMember,
          404: venueNotFound,
        },
      }),
      putConfig: defineEndpoint({
        method: "PUT",
        path: `${AVAILABILITY_CONFIG_PREFIX}/:id/availability/config`,
        params: VenueParamsSchema,
        body: PutAvailabilityConfigBodySchema,
        responses: {
          200: {
            description: "Saved; the new version and the audit row's id",
            body: z.object({ data: AvailabilityConfigSaveResultSchema }),
          },
          401: authRequired,
          403: problem("Caller is not a Manager of this venue"),
          404: venueNotFound,
          409: {
            description:
              "`version-conflict` (names the winning change) or `stranded-bookings` (route through the closure path)",
            body: AvailabilityConfigProblemSchema,
          },
          422: {
            description: "`invalid-config`, with path-addressed issues",
            body: AvailabilityConfigProblemSchema,
          },
        },
      }),
      closureImpact: defineEndpoint({
        method: "POST",
        path: `${AVAILABILITY_CONFIG_PREFIX}/:id/closures/impact`,
        params: VenueParamsSchema,
        body: ClosureImpactBodySchema,
        responses: {
          200: {
            description:
              "Future bookings the draft rule would affect, grouped by date and kind (read-only)",
            body: z.object({ data: ClosureImpactSchema }),
          },
          400: problem("Date range too long to evaluate"),
          401: authRequired,
          403: notClosureCaller,
          404: venueNotFound,
          422: {
            description: "`invalid-config`: the draft rule does not validate against the config",
            body: AvailabilityConfigProblemSchema,
          },
        },
      }),
      createClosure: defineEndpoint({
        method: "POST",
        path: `${AVAILABILITY_CONFIG_PREFIX}/:id/closures`,
        params: VenueParamsSchema,
        body: CreateClosureBodySchema,
        responses: {
          200: {
            description:
              "Saved atomically with its cancels and moves (or replayed from the same `Idempotency-Key`): the rule, the version and outcome counts",
            body: z.object({ data: ClosureResultSchema }),
          },
          400: problem("Missing `Idempotency-Key` header, or a date range too long to evaluate"),
          401: authRequired,
          403: notClosureCaller,
          404: venueNotFound,
          409: {
            description:
              "`version-conflict`, `idempotency-key-reused` (a different rule) or `closure-exists` (this rule id was already saved)",
            body: AvailabilityConfigProblemSchema,
          },
          422: {
            description:
              "`invalid-config`, `decision-required`, `invalid-decision` or `move-unavailable`",
            body: AvailabilityConfigProblemSchema,
          },
        },
      }),
      createClosures: defineEndpoint({
        method: "POST",
        path: `${AVAILABILITY_CONFIG_PREFIX}/:id/closures/batch`,
        params: VenueParamsSchema,
        body: CreateClosuresBodySchema,
        responses: {
          200: {
            description:
              "Every closure saved in one transaction (or replayed from the same `Idempotency-Key`): the version and one result per item, in order",
            body: z.object({ data: ClosuresResultSchema }),
          },
          400: problem("Missing `Idempotency-Key` header, or a date range too long to evaluate"),
          401: authRequired,
          403: problem("Caller is not a Manager of this venue"),
          404: venueNotFound,
          409: {
            description:
              "`version-conflict`, `idempotency-key-reused` or `closure-exists` (a rule id was already saved, or appears twice)",
            body: AvailabilityConfigProblemSchema,
          },
          422: {
            description:
              "`invalid-config`, `decision-required`, `invalid-decision` or `move-unavailable`; none of the items is saved",
            body: AvailabilityConfigProblemSchema,
          },
        },
      }),
      previewAvailability: defineEndpoint({
        method: "POST",
        path: `${AVAILABILITY_CONFIG_PREFIX}/:id/availability/preview`,
        params: VenueParamsSchema,
        body: PreviewAvailabilityBodySchema,
        responses: {
          200: {
            description:
              "The draft's effect: per-date added/removed times, the focus day, and a page of stranded reservations",
            body: z.object({ data: PreviewResultSchema }),
          },
          401: authRequired,
          403: problem("Caller is not a Manager of this venue"),
          404: venueNotFound,
          422: {
            description: "`invalid-config`, with path-addressed issues",
            body: AvailabilityConfigProblemSchema,
          },
          503: {
            description: "`preview-timeout`: the preview took longer than 5 seconds; retry is safe",
            body: AvailabilityConfigProblemSchema,
          },
        },
      }),
      listClosures: defineEndpoint({
        method: "GET",
        path: `${AVAILABILITY_CONFIG_PREFIX}/:id/closures`,
        params: VenueParamsSchema,
        responses: {
          200: {
            description:
              "One summary per date rule that produced closure outcomes (closures and Tonight close-early, reopened or ended ones included): Sent / Rebooked / Unreachable and refund counts",
            body: z.object({ data: ClosureSummariesSchema }),
          },
          401: authRequired,
          403: notMember,
          404: venueNotFound,
        },
      }),
      closureCallList: defineEndpoint({
        method: "GET",
        path: `${AVAILABILITY_CONFIG_PREFIX}/:id/closures/:ruleId/call-list`,
        params: ClosureParamsSchema,
        responses: {
          200: {
            description:
              "Guests the closure told but without a confirmed delivery or a rebooking: name, party, time and phone",
            body: z.object({ data: z.array(CallListEntrySchema) }),
          },
          401: authRequired,
          403: notMember,
          404: venueNotFound,
        },
      }),
      retryClosureRefunds: defineEndpoint({
        method: "POST",
        path: `${AVAILABILITY_CONFIG_PREFIX}/:id/closures/:ruleId/refunds/retry`,
        params: ClosureParamsSchema,
        responses: {
          200: {
            description:
              "Re-enqueued the closure's refunds that are `pending` or `failed` (never `done` or `none`, so nothing is refunded twice); works for a reopened closure or an ended Tonight change",
            body: z.object({ data: RetryRefundsResultSchema }),
          },
          401: authRequired,
          403: notClosureCaller,
          404: venueNotFound,
          503: problem(
            "The job queue failed partway; the detail says how many refunds were already queued. A row is only reset once its job exists, so retrying is safe"
          ),
        },
      }),
      reopenClosure: defineEndpoint({
        method: "DELETE",
        path: `${AVAILABILITY_CONFIG_PREFIX}/:id/closures/:ruleId`,
        params: ClosureParamsSchema,
        body: ReopenClosureBodySchema,
        responses: {
          200: {
            description: "Reopened; guests the closure cancelled stay cancelled",
            body: z.object({ data: ReopenResultSchema }),
          },
          401: authRequired,
          403: notClosureCaller,
          404: problem("Venue or closure not found"),
        },
      }),
      setTonight: defineEndpoint({
        method: "POST",
        path: `${AVAILABILITY_CONFIG_PREFIX}/:id/tonight`,
        params: VenueParamsSchema,
        body: SetTonightBodySchema,
        responses: {
          200: {
            description:
              "Saved for the current service day, ending at its boundary (or replayed from the same `ruleId`): the rule, the version, the day, `expiresAt` and outcome counts (all zero unless a close-early cancelled or moved bookings)",
            body: z.object({ data: TonightResultSchema }),
          },
          401: authRequired,
          403: notMember,
          404: venueNotFound,
          409: {
            description:
              "`version-conflict`, or `closure-exists` (this rule id was already used with a different change)",
            body: AvailabilityConfigProblemSchema,
          },
          422: {
            description:
              "`invalid-config`, or for a close-early with bookings `decision-required`, `invalid-decision` or `move-unavailable`",
            body: AvailabilityConfigProblemSchema,
          },
        },
      }),
      endTonight: defineEndpoint({
        method: "DELETE",
        path: `${AVAILABILITY_CONFIG_PREFIX}/:id/tonight/:ruleId`,
        params: TonightParamsSchema,
        responses: {
          200: {
            description: "Ended; bookings a close-early cancelled stay cancelled",
            body: z.object({ data: ReopenResultSchema }),
          },
          401: authRequired,
          403: notMember,
          404: problem("Venue or Tonight change not found"),
        },
      }),
      listDays: defineEndpoint({
        method: "GET",
        path: `${AVAILABILITY_CONFIG_PREFIX}/:id/availability/days`,
        params: VenueParamsSchema,
        query: AvailabilityDaysQuerySchema,
        responses: {
          200: {
            description: "One summary per service date in the range, for the calendar",
            body: z.object({ data: z.array(AvailabilityDaySummarySchema) }),
          },
          400: problem("Invalid or too long date range"),
          401: authRequired,
          403: notMember,
          404: venueNotFound,
        },
      }),
      check: defineEndpoint({
        method: "POST",
        path: `${AVAILABILITY_CONFIG_PREFIX}/:id/availability/check`,
        params: VenueParamsSchema,
        body: AvailabilityCheckBodySchema,
        responses: {
          200: {
            description: "The booking gate's verdict on this staff booking, with a human message",
            body: z.object({ data: AvailabilityCheckResultSchema }),
          },
          401: authRequired,
          403: notMember,
          404: venueNotFound,
        },
      }),
      listChanges: defineEndpoint({
        method: "GET",
        path: `${AVAILABILITY_CONFIG_PREFIX}/:id/availability/changes`,
        params: VenueParamsSchema,
        query: AvailabilityChangesQuerySchema,
        responses: {
          200: {
            description: "A page of the venue's availability history, newest first",
            body: z.object({ data: AvailabilityChangesPageSchema }),
          },
          401: authRequired,
          403: notMember,
          404: venueNotFound,
        },
      }),
      revertChange: defineEndpoint({
        method: "POST",
        path: `${AVAILABILITY_CONFIG_PREFIX}/:id/availability/changes/:changeId/revert`,
        params: VenueParamsSchema.extend({ changeId: z.string().describe("Availability change ID") }),
        body: RevertAvailabilityChangeBodySchema,
        responses: {
          200: {
            description: "Reverted as a new save; the new version and the revert's audit row id",
            body: z.object({ data: AvailabilityConfigSaveResultSchema }),
          },
          401: authRequired,
          403: problem("Caller is not a Manager of this venue"),
          404: problem("Venue or change not found"),
          409: {
            description:
              "`version-conflict`, `stranded-bookings`, `guests-notified`, `already-reverted`, `superseded` or `not-revertable`",
            body: AvailabilityConfigProblemSchema,
          },
          422: {
            description: "`invalid-config`: the stored inverse no longer validates",
            body: AvailabilityConfigProblemSchema,
          },
        },
      }),
    };

  <file path="src/endpoints/define.ts">
    export type HttpMethod = "GET" | "POST" | "PATCH" | "PUT" | "DELETE";
    export interface ProblemResponse {
      readonly kind: "problem";
      readonly description?: string;
    }
    export interface BodyResponse {
      readonly description?: string;
      readonly body: z.ZodType | null;
    }
    export type EndpointResponse = BodyResponse | ProblemResponse;
    export type EndpointResponses = { readonly [status: number]: EndpointResponse };
    export interface EndpointDefinition<
      M extends HttpMethod = HttpMethod,
      P extends string = string,
      Params extends z.ZodObject | undefined = z.ZodObject | undefined,
      Query extends z.ZodObject | undefined = z.ZodObject | undefined,
      Body extends z.ZodType | undefined = z.ZodType | undefined,
      R extends EndpointResponses = EndpointResponses,
    > {
      readonly method: M;
      /** Absolute path in Fastify syntax, e.g. /api/v1/guests/:id (prefix included). */
      readonly path: P;
      readonly params?: Params;
      readonly query?: Query;
      readonly body?: Body;
      readonly responses: R;
    }
    export type AnyEndpointDefinition = EndpointDefinition;
    type SuccessStatus = (typeof SUCCESS_STATUSES)[number];
    export type PathParamNames<P extends string> = P extends `${string}:${infer Param}/${infer Rest}`
      ? Param | PathParamNames<`/${Rest}`>
      : P extends `${string}:${infer Param}`
        ? Param
        : never;
    type IsUnion<T, U = T> = T extends unknown ? ([U] extends [T] ? false : true) : never;
    type SuccessKey<R> = Extract<keyof R, SuccessStatus>;
    type SameKeys<A, B> = [A] extends [B] ? ([B] extends [A] ? true : false) : false;
    type ParamsSchemaOf<D> = D extends { readonly params: infer X extends z.ZodObject } ? X : undefined;
    type ResponsesOf<D> = D extends { readonly responses: infer X } ? X : never;
    type DefinitionCheck<D extends AnyEndpointDefinition> = [PathParamNames<D["path"]>] extends [never]
      ? ParamsSchemaOf<D> extends z.ZodObject
        ? [params_declared_but_path_has_no_segment: never]
        : SuccessCheck<ResponsesOf<D>>
      : ParamsSchemaOf<D> extends z.ZodObject<infer Shape>
        ? SameKeys<keyof Shape, PathParamNames<D["path"]>> extends true
          ? SuccessCheck<ResponsesOf<D>>
          : [params_keys_must_equal_path_segments: never]
        : [path_has_segments_but_no_params_schema: never];
    type SuccessCheck<R> = [SuccessKey<R>] extends [never]
      ? [exactly_one_2xx_response_required_none_declared: never]
      : true extends IsUnion<SuccessKey<R>>
        ? [exactly_one_2xx_response_required_several_declared: never]
        : R[SuccessKey<R> & keyof R] extends ProblemResponse
          ? [a_2xx_response_cannot_be_a_problem_response: never]
          : [];
    export function defineEndpoint<const D extends AnyEndpointDefinition>(
      def: D,
      ..._contractCheck: DefinitionCheck<D>
    ): D {
      return def;
    }
    export function problem(description?: string): ProblemResponse {
      return description === undefined ? { kind: "problem" } : { kind: "problem", description };
    }
    export function isProblemResponse(response: EndpointResponse): response is ProblemResponse {
      return "kind" in response && response.kind === "problem";
    }
    export function successResponse(def: AnyEndpointDefinition): {
      status: number;
      response: BodyResponse;
    } {
      const entries = Object.entries(def.responses).filter(([status]) =>
        (SUCCESS_STATUSES as readonly number[]).includes(Number(status))
      );
      const only = entries.length === 1 ? entries[0] : undefined;
      if (!only || isProblemResponse(only[1])) {
        throw new Error(
          `${def.method} ${def.path}: endpoint definition needs exactly one 2xx body response, found ${entries.length}`
        );
      }
      return { status: Number(only[0]), response: only[1] };
    }
    type ParamsOf<D> = ParamsSchemaOf<D>;
    type QueryOf<D> = D extends { readonly query: infer X extends z.ZodObject } ? X : undefined;
    type BodyOf<D> = D extends { readonly body: infer X extends z.ZodType } ? X : undefined;
    type Simplify<T> = { [K in keyof T]: T[K] } & {};
    type Declared<K extends string, S, T> = S extends z.ZodType ? { [P in K]: T } : unknown;
    export type EndpointInput<D extends AnyEndpointDefinition> = Simplify<
      Declared<"params", ParamsOf<D>, z.input<NonNullable<ParamsOf<D>>>> &
        Declared<"query", QueryOf<D>, z.input<NonNullable<QueryOf<D>>>> &
        Declared<"body", BodyOf<D>, z.input<NonNullable<BodyOf<D>>>>
    >;
    type BodyOutput<Resp> = Resp extends { body: infer B }
      ? B extends z.ZodType
        ? z.output<B>
        : undefined
      : never;
    export type EndpointSuccess<D extends AnyEndpointDefinition> = BodyOutput<
      ResponsesOf<D>[SuccessKey<ResponsesOf<D>> & keyof ResponsesOf<D>]
    >;
    type ReplyOf<R> =
      | { [K in keyof R]: R[K] extends ProblemResponse ? never : BodyOutput<R[K]> }[keyof R]
      | ProblemDetails;
    export type EndpointRouteGeneric<D extends AnyEndpointDefinition> = Simplify<
      Declared<"Params", ParamsOf<D>, z.output<NonNullable<ParamsOf<D>>>> &
        Declared<"Querystring", QueryOf<D>, z.output<NonNullable<QueryOf<D>>>> &
        Declared<"Body", BodyOf<D>, z.output<NonNullable<BodyOf<D>>>> &
        (EndpointSuccess<D> extends undefined ? unknown : { Reply: ReplyOf<ResponsesOf<D>> })
    >;
  </file>
  <file path="src/endpoints/guests.ts">
    export const GUESTS_PREFIX = "/api/v1/guests";
    export const guestsEndpoints = {
      list: defineEndpoint({
        method: "GET",
        path: `${GUESTS_PREFIX}`,
        query: ListGuestsQuerySchema,
        responses: {
          200: {
            description: "Successful response with paginated guest list",
            body: paginatedResponseSchema(GuestSchema),
          },
          401: authRequired,
        },
      }),
      search: defineEndpoint({
        method: "GET",
        path: `${GUESTS_PREFIX}/search`,
        query: SearchGuestsQuerySchema,
        responses: {
          200: { description: "Search results", body: paginatedResponseSchema(GuestSchema) },
          401: authRequired,
        },
      }),
      getSegments: defineEndpoint({
        method: "GET",
        path: `${GUESTS_PREFIX}/segments`,
        query: GuestSegmentsQuerySchema,
        responses: {
          200: { description: "Guest segments", body: z.object({ data: z.array(GuestSegmentSchema) }) },
          401: authRequired,
        },
      }),
      get: defineEndpoint({
        method: "GET",
        path: `${GUESTS_PREFIX}/:id`,
        params: GuestIdParamsSchema,
        responses: {
          200: { description: "Guest found", body: guestEnvelope },
          404: guestNotFound,
        },
      }),
      create: defineEndpoint({
        method: "POST",
        path: `${GUESTS_PREFIX}`,
        body: CreateGuestBodySchema,
        responses: {
          201: { description: "Guest created", body: guestEnvelope },
          400: problem("Invalid request or duplicate email/phone"),
          401: authRequired,
        },
      }),
      findOrCreate: defineEndpoint({
        method: "POST",
        path: `${GUESTS_PREFIX}/find-or-create`,
        body: FindOrCreateGuestBodySchema,
        responses: {
          200: { description: "Guest found or created", body: guestEnvelope },
          400: problem("Invalid request"),
          401: authRequired,
        },
      }),
      update: defineEndpoint({
        method: "PATCH",
        path: `${GUESTS_PREFIX}/:id`,
        params: GuestIdParamsSchema,
        body: UpdateGuestBodySchema,
        responses: {
          200: { description: "Guest updated", body: guestEnvelope },
          404: guestNotFound,
        },
      }),
      addNote: defineEndpoint({
        method: "POST",
        path: `${GUESTS_PREFIX}/:id/notes`,
        params: GuestIdParamsSchema,
        body: AddGuestNoteBodySchema,
        responses: {
          201: { description: "Note appended; returns updated guest", body: guestEnvelope },
          400: problem("Invalid request"),
          401: authRequired,
          404: guestNotFound,
        },
      }),
      getLapsing: defineEndpoint({
        method: "GET",
        path: `${GUESTS_PREFIX}/lapsing`,
        query: LapsingGuestsQuerySchema,
        responses: {
          200: {
            description: "Lapsing guests list",
            body: z.object({ data: z.array(LapsingGuestSchema) }),
          },
          400: problem(),
          401: problem(),
        },
      }),
      sendWinBack: defineEndpoint({
        method: "POST",
        path: `${GUESTS_PREFIX}/:id/win-back`,
        params: GuestIdParamsSchema,
        responses: {
          200: { description: "Win-back result", body: z.object({ data: WinBackResultSchema }) },
          401: problem(),
          404: problem(),
        },
      }),
      delete: defineEndpoint({
        method: "DELETE",
        path: `${GUESTS_PREFIX}/:id`,
        params: GuestIdParamsSchema,
        responses: {
          204: { description: "Guest deleted", body: null },
          404: guestNotFound,
          409: problem("Guest has reservations"),
        },
      }),
    };

  <file path="src/schemas/agent.ts">
    export const AgentSessionStatusSchema = z.enum([
      "PENDING",
      "RUNNING",
      "SUCCEEDED",
      "FAILED",
      "CANCELLED",
    ]);
    export const AgentSessionSchema = z.object({
      id: z.string(),
      status: AgentSessionStatusSchema,
      taskDescription: z.string(),
      userId: z.string().nullable(),
      branchName: z.string().nullable(),
      baseBranch: z.string(),
      model: z.string(),
      maxTurns: z.number(),
      maxBudgetUsd: z.number(),
      createPr: z.boolean().optional(),
      prUrl: z.string().nullable(),
      prNumber: z.number().nullable(),
      resultText: z.string().nullable(),
      costUsd: z.number().nullable(),
      inputTokens: z.number().nullable(),
      outputTokens: z.number().nullable(),
      numTurns: z.number().nullable(),
      durationMs: z.number().nullable(),
      parentId: z.string().nullable(),
      errors: z.array(z.string()),
      startedAt: z.string().nullable(),
      completedAt: z.string().nullable(),
      createdAt: z.string(),
      updatedAt: z.string(),
    });
    export const AgentSessionEventSchema = z.object({
      id: z.string(),
      sessionId: z.string(),
      type: z.string(),
      data: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()).optional(),
      createdAt: z.string(),
    });
    export const CreateAgentSessionRequestSchema = z.object({
      taskDescription: z.string().min(1).max(10_000),
      model: z.string().optional(),
      maxTurns: z.number().min(1).max(200).optional(),
      maxBudgetUsd: z.number().min(0.01).max(10.0).optional(),
      baseBranch: z.string().optional(),
      createPr: z.boolean().optional(),
      parentId: z.string().optional(),
    });
  </file>
  <file path="src/schemas/api.ts">
    export const ProblemDetailsSchema = z
      .object({
        type: z.string().url().or(z.literal("about:blank")),
        title: z.string(),
        status: z.number().int().min(100).max(599),
        detail: z.string(),
        instance: z.string().optional(),
      })
      .catchall(z.unknown());
  </file>
  <file path="src/schemas/availability-config-api.ts">
    export const AvailabilityConfigChangesSchema = z.object({
      upsert: z
        .object({
          schedules: z.array(ScheduleSchema).optional(),
          venueServices: z.array(VenueServiceSchema).optional(),
          scheduleServices: z.array(ScheduleServiceSchema).optional(),
          assignments: z.array(ScheduleAssignmentSchema).optional(),
          dateRules: z.array(DateRuleSchema).optional(),
        })
        .default({}),
      remove: z
        .object({
          schedules: IdListSchema.optional(),
          venueServices: IdListSchema.optional(),
          scheduleServices: IdListSchema.optional(),
          assignments: IdListSchema.optional(),
          dateRules: IdListSchema.optional(),
        })
        .default({}),
    });
    export const SCOPE_CONFLICT_MODES = ["keep", "replace"] as const;
    export const ScopeConflictModeSchema = z.enum(SCOPE_CONFLICT_MODES);
    export const PutAvailabilityConfigBodySchema = z.object({
      /** The `version` the client read; a stale one is refused with 409 `version-conflict`. */
      expectedVersion: z.number().int().min(0),
      changes: AvailabilityConfigChangesSchema,
      scopeConflicts: ScopeConflictModeSchema.default("keep"),
    });
    export const AVAILABILITY_CONFIG_SOURCES = ["rows", "legacy", "empty", "unreadable"] as const;
    export const AvailabilityConfigSourceSchema = z.enum(AVAILABILITY_CONFIG_SOURCES);
    export const AvailabilityConfigStateSchema = z.object({
      config: AvailabilityConfigSchema,
      /** `Venue.availabilityVersion`; send it back as `expectedVersion`. */
      version: z.number().int(),
      source: AvailabilityConfigSourceSchema,
      /** `legacy` only: days the lenient reader closed, and values it coerced. */
      legacyNotes: z
        .object({ unreadableDays: z.array(z.string()), coercions: z.array(z.string()) })
        .optional(),
      /** `unreadable` only: why not even the lenient reader could read the hours. */
      legacyProblem: z.object({ reason: z.string(), detail: z.string() }).optional(),
    });
    export const AvailabilityConfigSaveResultSchema = z.object({
      version: z.number().int(),
      changeId: z.string(),
    });
    export const AvailabilityChangeSummarySchema = z.object({
      id: z.string(),
      actorId: z.string(),
      at: z.string(),
      kind: z.string(),
      summary: z.string(),
    });
    export const AvailabilityChangeEntrySchema = AvailabilityChangeSummarySchema.extend({
      /** First and last service dates the change can alter; `null` end means onward. */
      affectedFrom: ServiceDateSchema.nullable(),
      affectedTo: ServiceDateSchema.nullable(),
      /** Whether guests were told; a change that told them can never be undone. */
      notifiedGuests: z.boolean(),
      /** The change that undid this one. */
      revertedById: z.string().nullable(),
      /** `Revert` is offered only on the newest change, and only when it told no guest. */
      revertible: z.boolean(),
    });
    export const AVAILABILITY_CHANGES_MAX_LIMIT = 100;
    export const AvailabilityChangesQuerySchema = z.object({
      /** Made on or after this UTC date. */
      from: ServiceDateSchema.optional(),
      /** Made on or before this UTC date. */
      to: ServiceDateSchema.optional(),
      actorId: z.string().min(1).optional(),
      kind: z.string().min(1).optional(),
      limit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(AVAILABILITY_CHANGES_MAX_LIMIT).default(25),
      offset: z.coerce.number().int().min(0).default(0),
    });

      items: z.array(AvailabilityChangeEntrySchema),
    });

    export const SCHEDULE_KINDS = ["regular", "alternate", "holiday"] as const;
    export const DATE_RULE_KINDS = [
      "special_hours",
      "closure",
      "use_schedule",
      "skip",
      "tonight",
    ] as const;
    export const DATE_RULE_TARGETS = ["venue", "service", "booking", "tables"] as const;
    export const SERVICE_BOOKING_TYPES = ["online", "phone"] as const;
    export const RULE_BOOKING_TYPES = ["online", "phone", "waitlist"] as const;
    export const DATE_RULE_SOURCES = ["manual", "holiday", "tonight"] as const;
    export const CLOSURE_ACTIONS = ["cancel", "move", "keep_notify", "keep_silent"] as const;
    export const CLOSURE_REFUND_STATUSES = ["none", "pending", "done", "failed"] as const;
    export const ScheduleKindSchema = z.enum(SCHEDULE_KINDS);
    export const DateRuleKindSchema = z.enum(DATE_RULE_KINDS);
    export const DateRuleTargetKindSchema = z.enum(DATE_RULE_TARGETS);
    export const DateRuleSourceSchema = z.enum(DATE_RULE_SOURCES);
    export const ClosureActionSchema = z.enum(CLOSURE_ACTIONS);
    export const ClosureRefundStatusSchema = z.enum(CLOSURE_REFUND_STATUSES);
    export const GUEST_MESSAGE_MAX_LENGTH = 200;
    export const MinuteSchema = z.number().int().min(0).max(MINUTES_IN_TWO_DAYS);
    export const ServiceDateSchema = z.string().regex(/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01])$/);
    export const SeatingSchema = z.union([
      z.strictObject({ version: z.literal(1), interval: z.number().int().min(1).max(240) }),
      z.strictObject({ version: z.literal(1), fixed: z.array(MinuteSchema).min(1) }),
    ]);
    export const WindowSchema = z.object({
      version: z.literal(1),
      from: MinuteSchema,
      to: MinuteSchema,
    });
    export const RepeatSchema = z.object({
      version: z.literal(1),
      weekdays: z.array(WeekdayIndexSchema).min(1),
    });
    export const SpecialHoursServiceSchema = z.object({
      venueServiceId: IdSchema,
      ...ServiceHoursFields,
    });
    export const SpecialHoursPayloadSchema = z.object({
      version: z.literal(1),
      services: z.array(SpecialHoursServiceSchema),
    });
    export const TonightPayloadSchema = z.union([
      z.strictObject({
        version: z.literal(1),
        pacing: z.strictObject({ covers: z.number().int().min(1) }),
      }),
      z.strictObject({ version: z.literal(1), closeAt: MinuteSchema }),
      z.strictObject({
        version: z.literal(1),
        stop: z.strictObject({ from: MinuteSchema, to: MinuteSchema }),
      }),
    ]);
    export const ScheduleSchema = z.object({
      id: IdSchema,
      name: z.string().min(1).max(60),
      kind: ScheduleKindSchema,
      isRegular: z.boolean(),
      archivedAt: z.string().nullish(),
    });
    export const VenueServiceSchema = z.object({
      id: IdSchema,
      name: z.string().min(1).max(40),
      position: z.number().int(),
      archivedAt: z.string().nullish(),
    });
    export const ScheduleServiceSchema = z.object({
      id: IdSchema,
      scheduleId: IdSchema,
      venueServiceId: IdSchema,
      ...ServiceHoursFields,
    });
    export const ScheduleAssignmentSchema = z.object({
      id: IdSchema,
      scheduleId: IdSchema,
      weekdays: z.array(WeekdayIndexSchema).min(1),
      startsOn: ServiceDateSchema.nullish(),
      endsOn: ServiceDateSchema.nullish(),
      /** Larger wins where assignments overlap. */
      precedence: z.number().int(),
    });
    export const DateRuleSchema = z.discriminatedUnion("kind", [
      DateRuleBase.extend({
        kind: z.literal("special_hours"),
        payload: SpecialHoursPayloadSchema,
      }),
      DateRuleBase.extend({ kind: z.literal("closure") }),
      DateRuleBase.extend({ kind: z.literal("use_schedule"), useScheduleId: IdSchema }),
      DateRuleBase.extend({ kind: z.literal("skip") }),
      DateRuleBase.extend({
        kind: z.literal("tonight"),
        payload: TonightPayloadSchema,
        expiresAt: z.string().nullish(),
      }),
    ]);
    export const AvailabilityConfigSchema = z.object({
      schedules: z.array(ScheduleSchema),
      venueServices: z.array(VenueServiceSchema),
      scheduleServices: z.array(ScheduleServiceSchema),
      assignments: z.array(ScheduleAssignmentSchema),
      dateRules: z.array(DateRuleSchema),
    });
    export type Seating = z.infer<typeof SeatingSchema>;
    export type AvailabilityWindow = z.infer<typeof WindowSchema>;
    export type Repeat = z.infer<typeof RepeatSchema>;
    export type SpecialHoursService = z.infer<typeof SpecialHoursServiceSchema>;
    export type SpecialHoursPayload = z.infer<typeof SpecialHoursPayloadSchema>;
    export type TonightPayload = z.infer<typeof TonightPayloadSchema>;
    export type Schedule = z.infer<typeof ScheduleSchema>;
    export type VenueService = z.infer<typeof VenueServiceSchema>;
    export type ScheduleService = z.infer<typeof ScheduleServiceSchema>;
    export type ScheduleAssignment = z.infer<typeof ScheduleAssignmentSchema>;
    export type DateRule = z.infer<typeof DateRuleSchema>;
    export type AvailabilityConfig = z.infer<typeof AvailabilityConfigSchema>;
    export type ClosureAction = z.infer<typeof ClosureActionSchema>;

    export const PaginationSchema = z.object({
      page: z.number(),
      limit: z.number(),
      total: z.number(),
      totalPages: z.number(),
      hasNext: z.boolean(),
      hasPrev: z.boolean(),
    });
    export function paginatedResponseSchema<T>(itemSchema: z.ZodSchema<T>) {
      return z.object({
        data: z.array(itemSchema),
        pagination: PaginationSchema,
      });

    export const GUEST_CONTACT_REQUIRED_MESSAGE = "Either email or phone is required";
    export function hasGuestContact(contact: {
      email?: string | null | undefined;
      phone?: string | null | undefined;
    }): boolean {
      return Boolean(contact.email?.trim() || contact.phone?.trim());
    }
    export const AddGuestFormSchema = z
      .object({
        name: z.string().trim().min(1, "Name is required"),
        email: z.string().email("Please enter a valid email address").or(z.literal("")),
        phone: z
          .string()
          .regex(/^[+\d\s\-().]{7,}$/, "Please enter a valid phone number")
          .or(z.literal("")),
        notes: z.string(),
      })
      .refine(hasGuestContact, { message: GUEST_CONTACT_REQUIRED_MESSAGE, path: ["email"] });
    export type AddGuestFormValues = z.infer<typeof AddGuestFormSchema>;
  </file>

  <file path="src/schemas/json-schema.ts">
    function stripAdditionalProperties(obj: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
      const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(obj)) {
        if (key === "additionalProperties" || key === "propertyNames") continue;
        if (value !== null && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value)) {
          result[key] = stripAdditionalProperties(value as Record<string, unknown>);
        } else if (Array.isArray(value)) {
          result[key] = value.map((item) =>
            item !== null && typeof item === "object" && !Array.isArray(item)
              ? stripAdditionalProperties(item as Record<string, unknown>)
              : item
          );
        } else {
          result[key] = value;
        }
      }
      return result;
    }
    function stripRequestOverConstraints(obj: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
      const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      const hasFormat = typeof obj.format === "string";
      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(obj)) {
        if (key === "pattern" && hasFormat) continue;
        if (
          (key === "maximum" && value === Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) ||
          (key === "minimum" && value === -Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)
        ) {
          continue;
        }
        if (value !== null && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value)) {
          result[key] = stripRequestOverConstraints(value as Record<string, unknown>);
        } else if (Array.isArray(value)) {
          result[key] = value.map((item) =>
            item !== null && typeof item === "object" && !Array.isArray(item)
              ? stripRequestOverConstraints(item as Record<string, unknown>)
              : item
          );
        } else {
          result[key] = value;
        }
      }
      return result;
    }
    function toFastifyJsonSchema(id: string, zodSchema: ZodType) {
      const raw = toJSONSchema(zodSchema, {
        target: "draft-07",
        unrepresentable: "any",
      });
      const cleaned = stripAdditionalProperties(raw as Record<string, unknown>);
      const { $schema: _, ...rest } = cleaned;
      return { $id: id, ...rest };
    }
    export function toRequestJsonSchema(zodSchema: ZodType): Record<string, unknown> {
      const raw = toJSONSchema(zodSchema, {
        target: "draft-07",
        unrepresentable: "any",
      });
      const cleaned = stripRequestOverConstraints(
        stripAdditionalProperties(raw as Record<string, unknown>)
      );
      const { $schema: _schema, $id: _id, ...rest } = cleaned;
      return rest;
    }
    function stripRequired(obj: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
      const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(obj)) {
        if (key === "required" && Array.isArray(value)) continue;
        if (value !== null && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value)) {
          result[key] = stripRequired(value as Record<string, unknown>);
        } else if (Array.isArray(value)) {
          result[key] = value.map((item) =>
            item !== null && typeof item === "object" && !Array.isArray(item)
              ? stripRequired(item as Record<string, unknown>)
              : item
          );
        } else {
          result[key] = value;
        }
      }
      return result;
    }
    export function toResponseJsonSchema(zodSchema: ZodType): Record<string, unknown> {
      const raw = toJSONSchema(zodSchema, {
        target: "openapi-3.0",
        unrepresentable: "any",
        override: (ctx) => {
          const ref = SHARED_RESPONSE_REFS.get(ctx.zodSchema);
          if (!ref) return;
          // Zod's override hook is mutate-in-place by contract.
          for (const key of Object.keys(ctx.jsonSchema)) delete ctx.jsonSchema[key];
          ctx.jsonSchema.$ref = ref;
        },
      });
      const cleaned = stripRequired(stripAdditionalProperties(raw as Record<string, unknown>));
      const { $schema: _schema, ...rest } = cleaned;
      return rest;
    }

    export const ReservationStatusSchema = z.enum([
      "PENDING",
      "CONFIRMED",
      "CANCELLED",
      "COMPLETED",
      "NO_SHOW",
    ]);
    export const OccasionSchema = z.enum([
      "birthday",
      "anniversary",
      "business",
      "date_night",
      "other",
      "none",
    ]);
    export const SeatingPreferenceSchema = z.enum([
      "booth",
      "patio",
      "bar",
      "window",
      "quiet",
      "no_preference",
    ]);
    export const ReservationSchema = z.object({
      id: z.string(),
      date: z.string(),
      startTime: z.string(),
      endTime: z.string(),
      durationMinutes: z.number().optional(),
      partySize: z.number(),
      status: ReservationStatusSchema,
      notes: z.string().nullable(),
      cancellationReason: z.string().nullable(),
      cancellationNote: z.string().nullable(),
      occasion: OccasionSchema.nullable(),
      seatingPreference: SeatingPreferenceSchema.nullable(),
      guestName: z.string().nullable(),
      guestEmail: z.string().nullable(),
      guestPhone: z.string().nullable(),
      guestId: z.string().nullable(),
      userId: z.string().nullable(),
      /** Why staff booked past a soft availability limit; absent or null for an ordinary booking. */
      overrideReason: z.string().nullable().optional(),
      tableId: z.string(),
      table: TableSchema.optional(),
      guest: z
        .object({
          visitCount: z.number(),
          communicationPreference: z.string().nullable(),
          unsubscribed: z.boolean().optional(),
        })
        .nullable()
        .optional(),
      venueId: z.string().nullable(),
      createdAt: z.string(),
      updatedAt: z.string(),
    });
    export const DepositStatusSchema = z.enum([
      "pending",
      "held",
      "applied",
      "refunded",
      "partial_refunded",
      "forfeited",
      "uncollectable",
    ]);
    export const DepositSchema = z.object({
      id: z.string(),
      reservationId: z.string(),
      amountCents: z.number(),
      currency: z.string(),
      status: DepositStatusSchema,
      stripePaymentIntentId: z.string().nullable(),
      stripeCustomerId: z.string().nullable(),
      heldAt: z.string().nullable(),
      appliedAt: z.string().nullable(),
      refundedAt: z.string().nullable(),
      forfeitedAt: z.string().nullable(),
      // Optional (not just nullable) so a client validating against this schema
      // tolerates a response from an older, not-yet-redeployed server instance
      // that predates this field entirely (rolling-deploy skew).
      uncollectableAt: z.string().nullable().optional(),
      // Cumulative cents refunded (Stripe's own `amount_refunded`) AFTER this
      // deposit already reached a capture-based terminal status — e.g. a
      // dashboard-issued refund after our own capture (#5725). Same
      // rolling-deploy-skew tolerance as uncollectableAt above.
      postCaptureRefundCents: z.number().nullable().optional(),
      createdAt: z.string(),
      updatedAt: z.string(),
    });

    export const TEAM_ROLES = ["manager", "host"] as const;
    export const TeamRoleSchema = z.enum(TEAM_ROLES);
    export const TeamMemberSchema = z.object({
      userSub: z.string(),
      role: TeamRoleSchema,
      /** True for the caller's own membership row. */
      isViewer: z.boolean(),
      /**
       * True for a stored `owner` (shown as a Manager). Only an owner or a
       * platform admin may change an owner's role, so the owner marker is never
       * lost to a manager's demotion.
       */
      isOwner: z.boolean(),
    });
    export const VenueTeamSchema = z.object({
      members: z.array(TeamMemberSchema),
      /** "Hosts can close in an emergency" (`Venue.hostEmergencyClose`). */
      hostEmergencyClose: z.boolean(),
      /** The caller's role at this venue; platform admins count as a Manager. */
      viewerRole: TeamRoleSchema,
      /** True when the caller is an owner or a platform admin, the only callers who may change an owner's role. */
      viewerCanChangeOwners: z.boolean(),
    });
    export const UpdateTeamMemberRoleRequestSchema = z.object({ role: TeamRoleSchema });
    export const UpdateVenueTeamRequestSchema = z.object({ hostEmergencyClose: z.boolean() });
    export type TeamRole = z.infer<typeof TeamRoleSchema>;
    export type TeamMember = z.infer<typeof TeamMemberSchema>;
    export type VenueTeam = z.infer<typeof VenueTeamSchema>;
    export type UpdateTeamMemberRoleRequest = z.infer<typeof UpdateTeamMemberRoleRequestSchema>;
    export type UpdateVenueTeamRequest = z.infer<typeof UpdateVenueTeamRequestSchema>;
  </file>

    export function toPublicVenueProfile(stored: unknown): VenueProfile {
      const parsed = VenueProfileSchema.safeParse(stored ?? {});
      return parsed.success ? parsed.data : {};
    }

    export const VIP_TAG = "vip";
    export const VIP_VISIT_THRESHOLD = 10;
    export const REPEAT_VISIT_THRESHOLD = 2;
    export type GuestSegmentName = "VIP" | "Repeat" | "New";
    export function hasVipTag(tags: readonly string[] | null | undefined): boolean {
      return (tags ?? []).some((tag) => tag.toLowerCase() === VIP_TAG);
    }
    export function classifyGuestSegment(
      visitCount: number,
      tags: readonly string[] | null | undefined
    ): GuestSegmentName {
      if (hasVipTag(tags) || visitCount >= VIP_VISIT_THRESHOLD) return "VIP";
      if (visitCount >= REPEAT_VISIT_THRESHOLD) return "Repeat";
      return "New";
    }
  </file>

    export interface PartyFitTable {
      capacity: number;
      minCovers: number;
      maxCovers: number | null;
    }
    export function tableMaxCovers(table: Pick<PartyFitTable, "capacity" | "maxCovers">): number {
      return table.maxCovers ?? table.capacity;
    }
    export function partyFitsTable(table: PartyFitTable, partySize: number): boolean {
      return table.minCovers <= partySize && partySize <= tableMaxCovers(table);
    }

  <file path="src/schema-compat.ts">
    interface JsonSchemaProperty {
      type?: string;
      enum?: readonly unknown[];
      nullable?: boolean;
      description?: string;
      example?: unknown;
      [key: string]: unknown;
    }
    interface JsonSchema {
      $id?: string;
      type?: string;
      properties?: Record<string, JsonSchemaProperty>;
      required?: readonly string[];
      [key: string]: unknown;
    }
    export interface SchemaChange {
      type: "breaking" | "non-breaking";
      message: string;
    }
    export function compareSchema(
      schemaId: string,
      baseline: JsonSchema | undefined,
      current: JsonSchema | undefined
    ): { breaking: string[]; nonBreaking: string[] } {
      const breaking: string[] = [];
      const nonBreaking: string[] = [];
    
      if (!current) {
        breaking.push(`Schema "${schemaId}" was removed`);
        return { breaking, nonBreaking };
      }
    
      if (!baseline) {
        nonBreaking.push(`Schema "${schemaId}" is new`);
        return { breaking, nonBreaking };
      }
    
      const baseProps = baseline.properties ?? {};
      const currProps = current.properties ?? {};
      const baseRequired = new Set(baseline.required ?? []);
      const currRequired = new Set(current.required ?? []);
    
      // Removed properties
      for (const prop of Object.keys(baseProps)) {
        if (!(prop in currProps)) {
          breaking.push(`${schemaId}: property "${prop}" was removed`);
        }
      }
    
      // New properties
      for (const prop of Object.keys(currProps)) {
        if (!(prop in baseProps)) {
          if (currRequired.has(prop)) {
            breaking.push(
              `${schemaId}: required property "${prop}" was added (breaks existing clients)`
            );
          } else {
            nonBreaking.push(`${schemaId}: optional property "${prop}" was added`);
          }
        }
      }
    
      // Required constraint changes on existing fields
      for (const req of currRequired) {
        if (!baseRequired.has(req) && req in baseProps) {
          breaking.push(`${schemaId}: property "${req}" became required (was optional)`);
        }
      }
      for (const req of baseRequired) {
        if (!currRequired.has(req) && req in currProps) {
          nonBreaking.push(`${schemaId}: property "${req}" became optional (was required)`);
        }
      }
    
      // Property-level changes on shared fields
      for (const prop of Object.keys(baseProps)) {
        if (!(prop in currProps)) continue;
        const baseDef = baseProps[prop];
        const currDef = currProps[prop];
        if (!baseDef || !currDef) continue;
    
        // Type change
        if (baseDef.type && currDef.type && baseDef.type !== currDef.type) {
          breaking.push(
            `${schemaId}: property "${prop}" type changed from "${baseDef.type}" to "${currDef.type}"`
          );
        }
    
        // Enum narrowing
        if (baseDef.enum && currDef.enum) {
          const baseSet = new Set(baseDef.enum);
          const currSet = new Set(currDef.enum);
          const removed = [...baseSet].filter((v) => !currSet.has(v));
          const added = [...currSet].filter((v) => !baseSet.has(v));
    
          if (removed.length > 0) {
            breaking.push(`${schemaId}: property "${prop}" enum values removed: ${removed.join(", ")}`);
          }
          if (added.length > 0) {
            nonBreaking.push(`${schemaId}: property "${prop}" enum values added: ${added.join(", ")}`);
          }
        }
    
        // Nullable changes
        if (baseDef.nullable === true && currDef.nullable !== true) {
          breaking.push(`${schemaId}: property "${prop}" is no longer nullable`);
        }
        if (baseDef.nullable !== true && currDef.nullable === true) {
          nonBreaking.push(`${schemaId}: property "${prop}" became nullable`);
        }
    
        // Cosmetic changes
        for (const key of COSMETIC_KEYS) {
          if (JSON.stringify(baseDef[key]) !== JSON.stringify(currDef[key])) {
            nonBreaking.push(`${schemaId}: property "${prop}" ${key} changed`);
          }
        }
      }
    
      return { breaking, nonBreaking };
    }
  </file>

    export interface SsePayloadMap {
      "reservation:created": Reservation;
      "reservation:updated": Reservation;
      "reservation:cancelled": Reservation;
      "hold:created": ReservationHold;
      "hold:released": ReservationHold;
      "hold:confirmed": Reservation;
      "table:updated": Table;
      "floor-plan:created": FloorPlan;
      "guest:lapsing": LapsingGuest[];
      "table-status:changed": TableStatusDelta[];
    }
    export type SseEventName = keyof SsePayloadMap;
    export type SseQueryKey = "reservations" | "tables" | "floorPlans" | "lapsingGuests";
    export interface SseEventDefinition {
      /** Query-key roots to invalidate when this event arrives (may be empty). */
      readonly invalidates: readonly SseQueryKey[];
    }
    export const SSE_EVENT_CATALOG = {
      "reservation:created": { invalidates: ["reservations"] },
      "reservation:updated": { invalidates: ["reservations"] },
      "reservation:cancelled": { invalidates: ["reservations"] },
      "hold:created": { invalidates: [] },
      "hold:released": { invalidates: [] },
      "hold:confirmed": { invalidates: ["reservations"] },
      "table:updated": { invalidates: ["tables"] },
      "floor-plan:created": { invalidates: ["floorPlans"] },
      "guest:lapsing": { invalidates: ["lapsingGuests"] },
      "table-status:changed": { invalidates: [] },
    } as const satisfies { readonly [K in SseEventName]: SseEventDefinition };
    export const SSE_EVENT_NAMES = Object.keys(SSE_EVENT_CATALOG) as readonly SseEventName[];
    export type SseEvent<K extends SseEventName = SseEventName> = {
      [N in K]: {
        type: N;
        venueId: string;
        timestamp: string;
        data: SsePayloadMap[N];
      };
    }[K];
  </file>
  <file path="src/table-status.ts">
    export type TableDisplayStatus = "available" | "seated" | "needs-bussing" | "reserved-soon";
    export const RESERVED_SOON_WINDOW_MINUTES = 30;
    export interface TableDisplayStatusInput {
      /** The reservation currently or next occupying this table, or null if none. */
      reservation: Reservation | null;
      /**
       * Whether staff has confirmed an active seating hold on `reservation`
       * (e.g. a deposit hold or check-in), independent of the reservation's
       * own booking-lifecycle `status`. Ignored when `reservation` is null.
       */
      hasActiveHold: boolean;
      /** Current time, injected by the caller. */
      now: Date;
    }
    export function deriveTableDisplayStatus(input: TableDisplayStatusInput): TableDisplayStatus {
      const { reservation, hasActiveHold, now } = input;
    
      if (!reservation) {
        return "available";
      }
    
      if (reservation.status === "CANCELLED" || reservation.status === "NO_SHOW") {
        return "available";
      }
    
      if (reservation.status === "COMPLETED") {
        return "needs-bussing";
      }
    
      if (hasActiveHold) {
        return "seated";
      }
    
      const nowMs = now.getTime();
      const startMs = new Date(reservation.startTime).getTime();
      const endMs = new Date(reservation.endTime).getTime();
    
      if (nowMs >= endMs) {
        return "needs-bussing";
      }
    
      if (nowMs >= startMs) {
        return "seated";
      }
    
      const msUntilStart = startMs - nowMs;
      if (msUntilStart <= RESERVED_SOON_WINDOW_MINUTES * MS_PER_MINUTE) {
        return "reserved-soon";
      }
    
      return "available";
    }
    export interface TableStatusDelta {
      tableId: string;
      status: TableDisplayStatus;
    }
  </file>

    export interface DaySchedule {
      open: string; // "09:00" 24-hour format
      close: string; // "22:00"
      closed?: boolean;
    }
    export interface PacingRule {
      maxCoversPerSlot: number;
      timeWindowMinutes?: number; // override slot interval
    }
    export interface DurationRule {
      minPartySize: number;
      maxPartySize: number;
      durationMinutes: number;
    }
    export interface VenueSettings {
      defaultReservationDuration?: number; // minutes
      maxPartySize?: number;
      /** Contact phone number shown to guests whose party exceeds maxPartySize (#4979). */
      phone?: string;
      minAdvanceBooking?: number; // hours
      maxAdvanceBooking?: number; // days
      requirePhone?: boolean;
      requireEmail?: boolean;
      confirmationEmailEnabled?: boolean;
      reminderEmailEnabled?: boolean;
      // Availability settings
      slotIntervalMinutes?: number; // default 15
      lastSeatingBuffer?: number; // minutes before close, default 90
      holdDurationMinutes?: number; // default 10
      pacingRules?: PacingRule[];
      durationRules?: DurationRule[];
      /**
       * Number of no-shows that triggers automatic deposit requirement.
       * Risky guests (at or above this threshold) will always see the deposit step.
       * Default: 2
       */
      autoDepositAfterNoShows?: number;
      /** Guests cannot change a booking whose current start is less than this many hours away. */
      guestModificationCutoffHours?: number;
      /** Largest allowed |newPartySize - currentPartySize| for a guest self-service change. */
      guestMaxPartySizeChange?: number;
      /**
       * Public restaurant identity — venue type, cuisines, postal address,
       * website, description (#7250). Lives inside `settings` because `settings`
       * is already `Json?` on the `Venue` row, so this needed no migration. It is
       * the one key in this blob with a published public contract: see
       * `VenueProfileSchema` and `PublicVenueConfig.profile`.
       */
      profile?: VenueProfile;
      /** Per-venue palette; validate with `VenueThemeSchema` before use. */
      theme?: VenueTheme;
    }
    export type DepositType = "flat" | "per_person";
    export interface DepositConfig {
      enabled: boolean;
      depositType: DepositType | null;
      amountCents: number | null;
      currency: string;
      freeCancellationHours: number | null;
      lateCancellationFeePercent: number | null;
      noShowFeePercent: number | null;
    }
    export interface CreateVenueGroupRequest {
      name: string;
      slug: string;
      settings?: Record<string, unknown>;
    }
    export interface UpdateVenueGroupRequest {
      name?: string;
      slug?: string;
      settings?: Record<string, unknown>;
    }
    export interface CreateVenueRequest {
      venueGroupId?: string;
      name: string;
      slug: string;
      ianaTimezone: string;
      currencyCode?: string;
      operatingHours?: OperatingHours;
      settings?: VenueSettings;
    }
    export interface UpdateVenueRequest {
      venueGroupId?: string | null;
      name?: string;
      slug?: string;
      ianaTimezone?: string;
      currencyCode?: string;
      operatingHours?: OperatingHours | null;
      settings?: VenueSettings | null;
    }
    export interface PublicVenueDeposit {
      enabled: boolean;
      depositType: DepositType | null;
      amountCents: number | null;
      freeCancellationHours: number | null;
      lateCancellationFeePercent: number | null;
      noShowFeePercent: number | null;
    }
    export interface PublicVenueSettings {
      defaultReservationDuration?: number;
      maxPartySize?: number;
      maxAdvanceBooking?: number;
      slotIntervalMinutes?: number;
    }
    export interface PublicVenueConfig {
      name: string;
      slug: string;
      ianaTimezone: string;
      currencyCode: string;
      operatingHours: OperatingHours | null;
      settings: PublicVenueSettings;
      deposit: PublicVenueDeposit;
      /**
       * Allow-listed projection of `settings.profile` (#7250). `settings` is
       * free-form JSON, so this is built field by field through
       * `toPublicVenueProfile` — never spread — and the route's response
       * serializer drops anything the contract does not declare.
       */
      profile?: VenueProfile;
    }
    export interface CreateDepositPaymentIntentRequest {
      reservationId: string;
      guestEmail?: string;
      guestName?: string;
    }
    export interface DepositPaymentIntent {
      clientSecret: string;
      depositId: string;
      amountCents: number;
      currency: string;
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/waitlist.ts">
    export interface WaitlistJoinRequest {
      venueId: string;
      partySize: number;
      guestName: string;
      guestPhone: string;
    }
    export interface WaitlistJoinResult {
      /**
       * Signed, expiring capability for reading this one entry's live status
       * (`GET .../waitlist/status?token=`). The entry id itself is a guessable cuid
       * and is deliberately never exposed or accepted as the credential.
       */
      statusToken: string;
      position: number;
      estimatedWaitMinutes: number | null;
    }
    export interface WaitlistEstimate {
      position: number;
      estimatedWaitMinutes: number | null;
      status: WaitlistStatus;
    }
    export type WaitlistStatus = "waiting" | "notified" | "seated" | "expired" | "cancelled";
    export interface WaitlistEntry {
      id: string;
      venueId: string;
      partySize: number;
      guestName: string;
      guestPhone: string;
      position: number;
      estimatedWaitMinutes: number | null;
      status: WaitlistStatus;
      notifiedAt: string | null;
      expiresAt: string | null;
      createdAt: string;
      updatedAt: string;
    }
    export interface CreateWaitlistEntryRequest {
      venueId: string;
      partySize: number;
      guestName: string;
      guestPhone: string;
      avgTurnTimeMinutes?: number;
    }
  </file>
